02 · What We Found

We read all 37 of your campaigns and every flow that's actually live. Short version: you're good at today's sale, and you've built almost nothing to get the next one. Five things.

More emails, less money each time. Same "available now" on repeat. People open it, see nothing new, leave.

Finding 02

New subscribers get buried on day one.

Two welcome series are running at once. Sign up and three emails hit almost together. That's the first thing your brand says to someone. Right now it says too much.

Finding 03

A welcome flow, and almost nothing else.

No back-in-stock flow when a color restocks. No post-purchase follow-up. No win-back for people going quiet. You sell out constantly and there's no back-in-stock alert. That one hurts.

Finding 04
$9.39

One text outsells every email.

That's what your welcome text makes per person. More than any email you send. Text already pulls about a quarter of the revenue off basically one message. Imagine using it on purpose.

Finding 05

84% of your buyers never came back.

3,588 people have bought from SPUNGE. Only 579 ever bought twice. For a brand built on collecting colorways, that gap is the whole opportunity.

03 · The Point

You nail the sale. You built nothing for the next one.

Blasts get today's order. The flows get the repeat one. Back-in-stock, post-purchase, win-back. That's the money that stacks up, and it's barely here. That's the whole job.

Here’s what “the next one” actually looks like. Twelve campaigns we’d automate, so they run on their own, forever.

Post Purchase

The Colorway Story

Why this pair exists, from Salehe. Malawi, Feta, Nigiri. The founder is the moat, and no competitor can copy it.

Post Purchase

The Technical Story

How the shoe is actually built, and why each material was chosen. Roughly one in five buyers care deeply about the engineering. Give them the detail they came for.

Post Purchase

The Silhouette Story

Each new silhouette gets its own moment. As the 2027 models arrive, every launch earns a dedicated email, not just another drop in the feed.

Post Purchase

Complete the Set

“You own Feta and Orca. Nine to go.” The collector loop, and it cross-sells the lineup on its own.

Post Purchase

Tag to Win

Post a photo, tag @spunge, win store credit. Free content, free proof, free reach, every single order.

Post Purchase

First Look + VIP SMS

Opt into VIP texts and see the next colorway before anyone. The perk that captures the SMS list, where the money is.

Post Purchase

Bring a Friend

Give a friend early access, get store credit. Community growth baked straight into the buzz.

Post Purchase

How Are They Wearing?

A review request timed to real wear, around day 10, not day one. Buyers become the proof that sells the next drop.

Winback

It’s Been a Minute

Lapsed buyers see everything that dropped since they left. The gentle first tap on the shoulder.

Winback

The Offer Sandbox

Where we test what actually pulls people back. A quick $20 to cover shipping for a proven two-pair collector, never a fire sale.

Price Drop

Now’s the Time

A colorway gets marked down or a seasonal sale lands. Everyone who eyed it hears first.

Back in Stock

Back in Rotation

Not for the limited shoes. For evergreen SKUs, hats, tees, and any silhouette built to restock. The moment it returns, the people who missed it hear first.

01

Send less, earn more

We create up to 12 emails a month, segmented so no single subscriber gets all of them. Each send targets the right group, engaged buyers, lapsed customers, VIPs, so your list only hears from you when it's relevant. In November we lift frequency strategically, early access for loyalists and recent buyers, never a blast to the full list. Quality over volume.

05 · Where It Goes Next
Phase 2 · The Expansion

Once the basics earn, Phase 2 layers on three bigger levers. Loyalty, customer intelligence, and an ambassador program.

Phase 2A · Reward Collecting

A loyalty program, KITH-style

Not points-for-discounts. Access as the reward. Three tiers you climb by collecting and showing up, and each tier unlocks earlier drops, exclusive colorways and VIP treatment. Modeled on KITH, the streetwear gold standard: you earn on purchases and on engagement (drop check-ins, referrals, UGC), and the rewards make membership aspirational instead of transactional. Tier names below are illustrative.

Phase 2B · Know Your Customer

OuterSignal: see who’s really buying

A data layer that enriches every order with who the customer actually is: age, job, income, property value, social following, education. It auto-builds personas from your base and flags the VIPs, celebrities, athletes and 100M-follower creators already buying. Those signals sync into Klaviyo as tags, so we can trigger VIP flows, build Meta lookalike audiences, and power the ambassador recruiting in 2C from people already wearing the shoe.

The signal data across a live customer base

Real VIPs it flags, already buying

Klaviyo: VIP flows on signal tags Meta: lookalikes from top personas Segments: target by value & following Affiliate: recruit creators already buying
Phase 2C · Turn Fans Into Reach

The Connect: an ambassador program

Half the creators are already customers, and OuterSignal proves it. We turn them into a paid ambassador crew, modeled on StockX’s “The Connect”: each gets a personal storefront, shares their picks, and earns commission plus monthly cash bonuses. Warm recruitment from people who already own the shoe, never cold outreach.
